blocks.prompt: 6. Divide \(z_1 = 6(\cos 150^{\circ} + i\sin 150^{\circ})\) by \(z_2 = 3(\cos 30^{\circ} + i\sin 30^{\circ})\) and express in \(x + iy\) form.
blocks.explanation: Yeh do complex numbers ki taqseem (division) hai jo pehle hi polar form mein diye gaye hain. Agar inhein \(x + iy\) mein badal kar conjugate se taqseem karein to lamba kaam hoga; polar form mein yeh kaam do line ka hai. Humein \(z_1/z_2\) nikaal kar \(x + iy\) mein likhna hai. Plan: moduli taqseem karein, arguments minus karein (pehla minus doosra), phir \(120^{\circ}\) ke cos aur sin ki exact values lagayein.
steps:
Given (diya gaya hai): \(z_1 = 6(\cos 150^{\circ} + i\sin 150^{\circ})\), yani \(r_1 = 6\), \(\theta_1 = 150^{\circ}\); \(z_2 = 3(\cos 30^{\circ} + i\sin 30^{\circ})\), yani \(r_2 = 3\), \(\theta_2 = 30^{\circ}\).
To find (maloom karna hai): \(z_1/z_2\), \(x + iy\) form mein.
Method (tareeqa): polar form ka quotient rule, kyunke dono numbers pehle hi \(r(\cos\theta + i\sin\theta)\) ki shakal mein hain.

Qadam 1: Quotient rule likhein
\[\dfrac{z_1}{z_2} = \dfrac{r_1}{r_2}\,[\cos(\theta_1 - \theta_2)\]
\[+\, i\sin(\theta_1 - \theta_2)]\]
Kyun: polar form mein taqseem karne se moduli taqseem hote hain aur arguments minus. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: zarb mein angles jama, taqseem mein angles minus; bilkul powers ki tarah, \(\frac{a^{m}}{a^{n}} = a^{m - n}\).

Qadam 2: Values rakhein
\[\dfrac{r_1}{r_2} = \dfrac{6}{3} = 2\]
\[\theta_1 - \theta_2 = 150^{\circ} - 30^{\circ} = 120^{\circ}\]
\[\dfrac{z_1}{z_2} = 2(\cos 120^{\circ} + i\sin 120^{\circ})\]
Kyun: yeh polar form mein jawab hai; ab sirf cos aur sin ki values chahiye.
Dhyan dein: \(\theta_1 - \theta_2 = 150^{\circ} - 30^{\circ}\) hai, \(30^{\circ} - 150^{\circ}\) nahi. Tarteeb ulti ho to angle \(-120^{\circ}\) ban jata hai aur jawab ka imaginary part ulta ho jata hai.

Qadam 3: \(x + iy\) form mein badlein
\[\cos 120^{\circ} = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[\sin 120^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[\dfrac{z_1}{z_2} = 2\left(-\dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}i\right)\]
\[= -1 + i\sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: \(120^{\circ}\) second quadrant mein hai jahan cos negative aur sin positive hota hai; reference angle \(180^{\circ} - 120^{\circ} = 60^{\circ}\) hai, is liye values \(\cos 60^{\circ}\) aur \(\sin 60^{\circ}\) wali hain. Phir 2 andar zarb kiya.

Tasdeeq (check):
Jawab ko \(z_2\) (rectangular form mein) se zarb karein; \(z_1\) wapas aana chahiye.
\[z_2 = \tfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} + \tfrac{3}{2}i\]
\[(-1 + i\sqrt{3})\,z_2:\]
\[\text{Re} = -\tfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} - \tfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{2} = -3\sqrt{3}\]
\[\text{Im} = -\tfrac{3}{2} + \tfrac{9}{2} = 3\]
aur \(z_1 = 6\left(-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \dfrac{1}{2}i\right) = -3\sqrt{3} + 3i\). Dono barabar hain.
Kyun: quotient \(\times\) divisor = dividend, jaise \(\frac{12}{3} = 4\) ka check \(4 \times 3 = 12\) hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2} = -1 + i\sqrt{3}\) (polar form mein \(2(\cos 120^{\circ} + i\sin 120^{\circ})\): lambai 2, direction \(120^{\circ}\)).
